english.title: Use aerodynamic device / equipment on vehicle / vehicle combination

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicle construction and use regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used

(A)_[an aerodynamic device]_
(B)_[an aerodynamic device and equipment]_

on a

(C)_[vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]_
(D)_[vehicle combination, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE COMBINATION..),]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), otherwise than permitted by regulation 96A of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 96A of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used any aerodynamic devices
on any vehicle / vehicle combination
on a road
otherwise than permitted by regulation 96A

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Fixed penalty tickets may be issued for this offence, see Schedule 3 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988; the amount is £50 (section 53 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 and Schedule 1 to the Fixed Penalty Order 2000).
(ii) Where it can be shown that the use of the rear aerodynamic devices has been dangerous, consider breach of regulation 100 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
